I'm N'Meboon's server helper bot — I use keyword/similarity matching against a knowledge base to answer common questions. I'm not a full conversational AI, so I work best with direct questions about server rules, verification, XP, or regions.

question_examples: how do i use this bot
answer: Here's what I can help with: /summon card:Information (server rules), /summon card:Region (pick your continent/country), /summon card:Feedback (send feedback, report a bug, or ask a question). You can also just ask me things like 'are gifs allowed' or 'how do I verify'.

question_examples: can i send lots of messages fast
am i allowed to flood chat
answer: Spamming (sending messages too fast/repeatedly) isn't allowed — it's a Low level rule violation and can get you muted for 3–60 minutes if it adds up to enough points.

question_examples: can i send gifs in chat
answer: GIFs aren't allowed in chat. Any GIF you post gets auto-deleted immediately — no penalty, it's just removed.

question_examples: can i tag a lot of people
answer: Excessive pinging (like @everyone or tagging a bunch of people at once) isn't allowed — it's a Low level rule and can lead to a mute.

question_examples: can i share a website here
answer: Links aren't allowed in chat. Any link you post gets auto-deleted immediately — no penalty, it's just removed.

question_examples: what happens if i post nsfw
answer: NSFW and violent content are strictly not allowed (High level). This is taken seriously and can lead to longer mutes (10 minutes to 48 hours).

question_examples: how long do i get muted for
answer: Penalties scale with rule level: Low < 15 pts = mute 3–60 min. Mid < 10 pts = mute 5–180 min. High < 5 pts = mute 10 min to 48 hours. Fewer points needed at higher severity means it escalates faster.

To verify: click 'Verify My Account' on the info card, then click 'It's Me!' in the DM I send you — I'll give you an OTP code there. Come back to the info card and click 'Enter OTP' to type it in and get verified.

You earn 1 XP per chat message and 10 XP per minute in a voice channel. Level requirements grow the higher you go (like Minecraft). Level-ups get announced automatically and shown in your nickname, and there are monthly/yearly XP leaderboards.

question_examples: how do i set my region
how do i get a country role
where do i pick my continent

answer: Use /summon card:Region to pick your continent and country from the menus — this gives you the matching region roles. You can change your pick anytime.

question_examples: how do i report a bug
answer: Use /summon card:Feedback — you'll get buttons to send feedback, report a bug, or ask a question directly.
